I like the idea of more promo villains. No, I LOVE it. The Baron Blade and Omnitron promos are really interesting and fun to play, especially Baron Blade. Since I've had this game since it's very first release, Baron Blade has always been the "tutorial" villain in my mind. Always really simple, never a challenge, and only a slight challenge on advanced. But when they came out with his promo cards, I was like "Whoa. Blade just got scarier." So I want more. MORE!

I don't know how we'll get them, but I want them. It doesn't look like we're getting any from this kickstarter. I'd rather have a couple more promo villains than the token pack we're about to receive. Not that I'm ungrateful for the extra tokens, but the EE box is already low on space, and we're going to need to account for five more villains, (likely) three environments, and (likely) three heroes. I'm not sure why tokens were chosen over something like the promo villains.

But really, I'm sure I'm not the only one who wants more of those. However, I'm gonna take a guess and say that we aren't getting any as of now because we're getting SEVEN promo heroes, so production costs on more promos might be the problem. But maybe we can hope for more in the future. Or if we make it a little further beyond $100K.

Though, on the twitter, I'm pretty sure I read that Shattered Timelines will be the last kickstarter GTG will be doing. Which is amazing and a big achievement that they won't need it anymore, but then how are we going to get rewards in the future?!

Sure, it's a different and possible way of getting her golems out, but 4 HP is a steep hit for just one golem. I like Braithwhite's idea from earlier about Expatriette's promo power, and I've been trying to think of one for her as well. The "Target Lock" power is a pretty good idea, but I'm afraid that might make her a little too strong. Honestly, the problem I'd like to be a little more addressed is her using her ammo cards. I don't know if it's just me, but I seem to hardly ever use Expatriette's ammo cards. And I know there's plenty of ways the deck allows you to use them effectively, like Reload or Speed Loading, but I still hardly ever seem to use ammo with the guns. Maybe I just haven't gotten those cards in a timely fashion and been able to use them to their fullest potential. This might all just be my poor luck or poor play style of her deck. So I thought maybe she could use a power like...

Conserving Ammo: Destroy a gun card. If you do, you may put up to two ammo cards into play.

If that were the power, I could see this play style more or less relvoving around loading up Pride & Prejudice and using them as your main weapons, sacrificing the other guns she has. But again, I know that she's got Speed Loading and Reload to make her use her ammo quicker and more effectively. So, maybe something like this instead:

Conserving Resources: Discard a gun card. If you do, draw 2 cards.

That way, it just gets her to move a little faster through her deck, and hopefully closer to Reload, Speed Loading, and all the other ammo cards. In that process, you'll come across more guns to sacrifice.

Any problems with this? Any implications I might have missed?
